title: Smoothness of exponential-family parameter hairs
exact_target: Are the parameter hairs smooth to every order or analytic, and where and in what way do they end?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300062 (AMR-052-0062). CC BY 4.0.

Robert Devaney, ``Open Questions in Non-Rational Complex Dynamics'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), second problem in Section 3 (parameter hairs), pp. 36; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
